wf_token.label: WeatherFlow token
wf_token.description: Personal access token from tempestwx.com, Settings, Data Authorizations.

wf_station_id.label: WeatherFlow station ID
wf_station_id.description: The number in your tempestwx.com station URL.

aqi_url.label: AQI JSON URL
aqi_url.description: A URL returning JSON with an "aqi" number, like the tahome proxy at api.shawn.party. Used first when set; it already smooths and EPA-corrects the sensor.

purpleair_api_key.label: PurpleAir API read key
purpleair_api_key.description: Used only when the AQI JSON URL is empty. A READ key from the API Keys tab at develop.purpleair.com (a long UUID), not the 16-character sensor read key.

purpleair_sensor_index.label: PurpleAir sensor index
purpleair_sensor_index.description: The number in the map URL (select=...).

purpleair_host.label: PurpleAir local address
purpleair_host.description: LAN IP of the sensor, used only when no API key is set. Needs the bar to reach the sensor's network.

epa_correction.label: US EPA correction
epa_correction.description: Apply the EPA PurpleAir correction to PM2.5 before computing AQI, as the PurpleAir map does.

show_details.label: Details page
show_details.description: Feels-like, humidity, rain today and UV.

page_seconds.label: Seconds per page
page_seconds.description: 0 keeps the page you picked with the wheel.

alerts.label: Alert sounds
alerts.description: While HoffWeather is open: chime and blink the LED when lightning is near, rain starts, or the AQI turns unhealthy. Silent in quiet hours and during a BUSY session.

alert_lightning_distance.label: Lightning alert within
alert_lightning_distance.description: Miles, or km with metric units. 0 turns the lightning alert off.

alert_rain.label: Rain alert
alert_rain.description: When rain starts after at least 30 dry minutes.

alert_aqi.label: AQI alert
alert_aqi.description: When the AQI rises into Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups (over 100) or worse.

quiet_start.label: Quiet hours start
quiet_start.description: No alert sounds from here until the end time. Same start and end means no quiet hours.

wf_base_url.label: WeatherFlow API base
wf_base_url.description: Leave as is unless you proxy the API. The app appends /rest/observations/station/<id>.
